  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through the greater descent of physical mitzvos, one reaches the highest ascent, surpassing even Torah study.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, according to what was stated above, that specifically through the descent downward and downward can one effect that the ascent be upward and upward,</t>
    <t s="2">to a place higher than the place from which the descent originated,</t>
    <t s="3">it is also understood the superiority of the matter of action (deed) relative to the matter of study,</t>
    <t s="4">for this is the general distinction between commandments</t>
    <t s="5">(action)</t>
    <t s="6">and Torah</t>
    <t s="7">(study).</t>
    <t s="8">For, behold,</t>
    <t s="9">Torah, its matter is a drawing down from above to below,</t>
    <t s="10">and together with this,</t>
    <t s="11">"Behold, My words are like fire, etc."66,</t>
    <t s="12">therefore words of Torah do not receive impurity67,</t>
    <t s="13">meaning,</t>
    <t s="14">that even when they are found below,</t>
    <t s="15">and even with one who is in a state and condition opposite to purity,</t>
    <t s="16">even there they do not receive impurity.</t>
    <t s="17">However, the commandments, their matter is specifically in physical things68,</t>
    <t s="18">to the extent that even the commandments whose matter is understanding and comprehension in the brain or feeling in the heart,</t>
    <t s="19">they are connected to physical limbs,</t>
    <t s="20">the physical brain and the physical heart,</t>
    <t s="21">and particularly according to what is explained in many places69,</t>
    <t s="22">that the perfection of the service in fulfilling these commandments is when a change is also made in the physicality of the vessel of the brain and the vessel of the heart</t>
    <t s="23">(contraction and expansion and extension).</t>
    <t s="24">And since in the commandments there is a matter of descent further downward</t>
    <t s="25">(into physicality),</t>
    <t s="26">therefore specifically through them one reaches the highest of the high.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>There are two opinions on whether study or action is greater, reflected in the two orders of the Shema paragraphs.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And the explanation of the matter:</t>
    <t s="2">Behold, there are two opinions70</t>
    <t s="3">(and these and those are the words of the living G-d71)</t>
    <t s="4">whether study is greater or action is greater.</t>
    <t s="5">And this is also the difference between the two orders in the verse</t>
    <t s="6">(as above, that these and those are the words of the living G-d),</t>
    <t s="7">the order in the first portion of the Shema,</t>
    <t s="8">that first it says "and you shall teach them" and afterwards it says "and you shall bind them,"</t>
    <t s="9">according to the opinion that study is greater</t>
    <t s="10">(for precedence in Torah indicates precedence in level),</t>
    <t s="11">and the order in the second portion of the Shema,</t>
    <t s="12">that first it says "and you shall bind them" and afterwards it says "and you shall teach them,"</t>
    <t s="13">according to the opinion that action is greater72.</t>
    <t s="14">And the explanation of this:</t>
    <t s="15">Behold,</t>
    <t s="16">the matter of study is simply in order to know the deed that one should do and those that one should not do73</t>
    <t s="17">(this being the general matter of the commandments,</t>
    <t s="18">positive commandments and negative commandments),</t>
    <t s="19">and only afterwards can one speak of the actual fulfillment of the commandments.</t>
    <t s="20">And this is the reason that study is greater,</t>
    <t s="21">because study brings to action</t>
    <t s="22">(as explained in the Laws of Torah Study by the Alter Rebbe74).</t>
    <t s="23">That is,</t>
    <t s="24">the matter of study is connected to the head of the person,</t>
    <t s="25">which is called "head" because it is prior in level and rules and governs over the entire body,</t>
    <t s="26">and its parallel is the matter of the commandments,</t>
    <t s="27">248 positive commandments corresponding to 248 limbs and 365 negative commandments corresponding to 365 sinews75,</t>
    <t s="28">which are lower than the head,</t>
    <t s="29">therefore the decision of the head must come first as to how the conduct of the body will be.</t>
    <t s="30">And only when there already exist both matters of Torah and commandments,</t>
    <t s="31">then there is room for two opinions as to what precedes,</t>
    <t s="32">study or action,</t>
    <t s="33">even to the second opinion that action is greater,</t>
    <t s="34">due to the superiority that specifically through the descent downward</t>
    <t s="35">(this being analogous to the general superiority of the month of Av,</t>
    <t s="36">as above).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Nevertheless, study precedes action as a necessary preparation, just as bread must be prepared before it can sustain a person.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And nevertheless it says "and you shall teach them" before "and you shall bind them,"</t>
    <t s="1">study before action,</t>
    <t s="2">because,</t>
    <t s="3">even though the superiority of action is great,</t>
    <t s="4">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="5">in order for the matter of action to be possible, the matter of study, which brings to action, must first exist.</t>
    <t s="6">And as it is in the general service of man,</t>
    <t s="7">that even though it was stated above</t>
    <t s="8">(in section 4)</t>
    <t s="9">that the vitality of man is specifically through "every utterance of the mouth of G-d" in the bread that is lower than man</t>
    <t s="10">(due to the superiority of specifically the descent downward),</t>
    <t s="11">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="12">in order for man to live through eating bread, one must first prepare the bread so that it is fit for human consumption,</t>
    <t s="13">as it is stated in the Gemara76</t>
    <t s="14">"Does a person bring wheat and chew it?"</t>
    <t s="15">(in astonishment),</t>
    <t s="16">rather, one must make the wheat into human food</t>
    <t s="17">(through the "helpmeet opposite him"77).</t>
    <t s="18">And likewise is it with the matter of study and action,</t>
    <t s="19">that even though action is greater</t>
    <t s="20">(due to the superiority of the descent downward),</t>
    <t s="21">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="22">in order for the matter of action to be possible, the preparation of study must exist.</t>
    <t s="23">And through this, an additional quality of action is also added to study,</t>
    <t s="24">just as an addition is made to the person through eating bread,</t>
    <t s="25">as above.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
